title: Antique Copper Shower Door Handle - Clearview Single-Side Shower Door Pull, 9-Inch Solid Brass With Acrylic Accents, Concealed Mounting, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Antique Copper, get a secure, comfortable grip that looks clean and architectural every time you open your shower door—backed by a limited lifetime warranty, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms.

  • Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Match your decor: acrylic accents add a light, open feel for modern bathroom hardware.
  • Install with confidence: includes the shower door pull and all installation hardware.
  • Coordinate the room: part of the Clearview collection for a consistent contemporary style.

Specs

  • Product type: Single-side shower door pull / shower door handle
  • Mounting: Shower door mount; concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Material: Brass with acrylic accents
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 13 x 3.9 x 1.7 in
  • Pull length: 9 in
  • Weight: 3.2 lb
  • In the box: Shower door pull and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Clearview collection.
meta_description: Modern shower door handle with a 9-inch solid brass pull and acrylic accents. Concealed screw mount for a clean look, plus limited lifetime warranty.
